snippet.title: JashiiCorrin
snippet.description:
Got big goals but struggling to follow through? I got you! 

Hi team! I'm Jess, or JashiiCorrin 💜 I love all things productivity, planning, and personal development (and alliteration 😝). I share realistic goal-getting strategies that actually work in real life, especially if you need flexibility and structure. Together we'll turn big goals into tiny, doable actions and keep going even when motivation dips 💪

I believe that SMART goals are lowkey a scam, and that you don't need more discipline to make things happen. You just need a system that accounts for the real you, not some idealised perfect version. 

My mission is to help you plan and action your goals, and achieve the things you're dreaming of. If you want practical application (not just theory), supportive accountability, and a friendly reminder that you’ve done hard things and you can do hard things, stick around! 

Let's get things done together 😄

For business and collaboration enquires, email me at hello@jashii.com

snippet.title: Maisy Leigh
snippet.description:
Rebuilding life, one ritual at a time 🍵
Hi, I’m Maisy — a self-taught designer and founder of Cozyleigh Studios, a cozy design studio I run with my partner and sister.

After losing my mom at 23, I learned firsthand how short life is — and made the decision to stop living the path I was ‘supposed’ to follow, and to start following my gut & my heart. I left my career as a software engineer, taught myself design, and chose a slower, more intentional path rooted in creativity, family, and everyday rituals that make life feel warm again.

This channel is my diary. You’ll find cozy vlogs, studio life, desk setups, matcha mornings, and reflections on healing, building a chosen family, and designing a life you don’t need to escape.

If you’re drawn to intentional living, creative work, and finding beauty in the quiet moments — I’m really glad you’re here.

🌿 Find me here: https://instagram.com/maisyleigh | https://cozyleigh.studio

snippet.title: Andrew Adriance
snippet.description:
Wake up everyday with clarity and purpose. Do you want that? I sure do.

I think you need to understand three things to make that happen:
- Your story: where did you come from in life.
- Introspection: Where are you now.
- Vision: What is the vision for the world you want to live in?

If that all sounds interesting to you, join in and subscribe as I visit topics every week about what's going on in the world and what experts from different fields have to say about it. Most importantly, what do we do with that information to wake up with a better sense of clarity every day?

snippet.title: Julian Ivanov | KI-Automatisierung
snippet.description:
Hi! Ich bin Julian und ich zeige dir, wie du mit KI & Automatisierung deinen Alltag und deine Arbeit smarter machst. 

Nach meinem Studium in Künstlicher Intelligenz und über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der KI-Entwicklung weiß ich, was funktioniert und was nicht. Dieses Wissen teile ich hier. In meiner Community bringe ich Selbstständigen, Freelancern und Unternehmern bei, KI-Automatisierung zu meistern und sich damit ein eigenes Business aufzubauen. 

Egal ob du Selbständig bist, im Job effizienter werden willst oder dich einfach für KI interessierst und gerne neue Tools ausprobierst, hier bist du richtig. Auf meinem Kanal bekommst du praktische Tutorials zu n8n, Claude Code, OpenClaw und weiteren KI-Tools, die im Alltag wirklich funktionieren. Ich zeige dir Systeme, die du sofort umsetzen kannst, um Zeit zu sparen, Kosten zu senken und dein persönliches Wachstum zu beschleunigen.

Über Crystalflow AI berate und integriere ich zusätzlich maßgeschneiderte KI-Lösungen direkt in Unternehmen.
